explication: Spring Cloud Alibaba is a collection of Spring Cloud integrations for distributed application development. The principal documented workflow is to configure a Spring application with Alibaba components, then use their Spring-managed capabilities for discovery, configuration, traffic governance, messaging, transactions, and scheduling. The graph also includes the sampled storage-service example as a concrete request-to-result flow. Several feature nodes are documented capabilities whose implementation was not sampled; their paths identify existing source directories, and their internal wiring is not inferred.
